mission: Apply the D2-04 blind-audit adjudications to the ownership gold as VERSIONED append-only correction records (originals never rewritten), then re-run the S3 ownership evaluator (ownership-bench-v1, packages/swing-lab/src/ownershipBench.ts) and report before/after on the corrected labels.
correctionPolicy: Only auditor-upheld adjudications become corrections. resolved-to-waveC, downgraded-to-ambiguous, partial (presence agreed / certifiability contested, waveC omission ruled defensible: ADJ-D1), and unresolved-classification (ADJ-D3) adjudications are recorded as no-change dispositions. Corrections live in new sidecar files of kind 'ownership-correction-set' (schemaVersion 1); each record cites its adjudicationId and, for supersede-point, the exact original point it supersedes. Original waveC files are byte-identical to before. The evaluator applies corrections in memory only when --apply-corrections is passed, so the uncorrected baseline remains reproducible from the same tree.
